card.text: Red dwarf 38 parsecs away that hosts the planet K2-18 b.

introduction.text: K2-18 is a red dwarf 38 parsecs away, about four tenths of the Sun’s radius. Its planet K2-18 b circles it every 33 days.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of a measured spectrum of the star. The darker edge is a model, not a measurement.
